title: Sereja and Dividing
statementMd:
Let's assume that we have a sequence of doubles $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{|*a*|}$ and a double variable $*x*$. You are allowed to perform the following two-staged operation:

1. choose an index of the sequence element $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ |*a*|)$;
2. consecutively perform assignments: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b426fdcc6fd38581932140e0bb197d498127aa5d.png).

Let's use function $*g*(*a*, *x*)$ to represent the largest value that can be obtained from variable $*x*$, using the described operation any number of times and sequence $*a*$.

Sereja has sequence $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{|*b*|}$. Help Sereja calculate sum: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4f61e6a9a81c6dc734076a21fba5d0783b72616.png). Record $[*b*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i* + 1}, ..., *b*_{*j*}]$ represents a sequence containing the elements in brackets in the given order. To avoid problems with precision, please, print the required sum divided by $|*b*|^{2}$.

## Input

The first line contains integer $|*b*|$ $(1 ≤ |*b*| ≤ 3·10^{5})$ — the length of sequence $*b*$. The second line contains $|*b*|$ integers $*b*_{1}$, $*b*_{2}$, $...$, $*b*_{|*b*|}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$.

## Output

In a single line print a real number — the required sum divided by $|*b*|^{2}$. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error won't exceed $10^{ - 6}$.
statementZhMd:
假设我们有一个双精度浮点数序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{|*a*|}$ 和一个双精度浮点数变量 $*x*$。你可以执行以下两阶段操作：

1. 选择序列元素的一个下标 $*i*$ $(1 ≤ *i* ≤ |*a*|)$；
2. 依次执行赋值操作：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b426fdcc6fd38581932140e0bb197d498127aa5d.png)。

我们用函数 $*g*(*a*, *x*)$ 表示使用序列 $*a*$，执行任意次上述操作后，变量 $*x*$ 所能取得的最大值。

Sereja 有一个序列 $*b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, ..., *b*_{|*b*|}$。请帮助 Sereja 计算以下总和：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4f61e6a9a81c6dc734076a21fba5d0783b72616.png)。记号 $[*b*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i* + 1}, ..., *b*_{*j*}]$ 表示一个按给定顺序包含方括号内元素的序列。为避免精度问题，请输出所求总和除以 $|*b*|^{2}$ 的结果。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $|*b*|$ $(1 ≤ |*b*| ≤ 3·10^{5})$，表示序列 $*b*$ 的长度。第二行包含 $|*b*|$ 个整数 $*b*_{1}$、$*b*_{2}$、...、$*b*_{|*b*|}$ $(1 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个实数，即所求总和除以 $|*b*|^{2}$ 的结果。如果答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则视为正确。
